title: Linux - Software Information (formerly Software Information)
html:
Software Information

Installed software adds authentication hooks, management interfaces, and service-specific behavior to a Linux host. Identify the installed component and its privileges, then review the relevant page:

  • Local web and authentication services maps host-side web, proxy, PAM, LDAP, mail, and CI surfaces.
  • Databases and secret material covers local DB endpoints, application configs, key stores, and tokens.
  • PAM: Pluggable Authentication Modules covers Linux authentication modules and configuration.
  • FreeIPA pentesting covers identity-management deployments.
  • Logstash covers service-specific attack surfaces.
  • Splunk LPE and persistence covers local escalation and persistence paths in Splunk deployments.
  • Node inspector and CEF debugger abuse covers exposed debugging interfaces.
  • Android rooting framework manager auth bypass and syscall hooks covers that specialized Linux-based software stack.
